responsibility: Declares the main interfaces and shared state for x86 target option handling. It exposes processor-selection globals, stack-boundary and ISA state, target-string and offload-option helpers, function-specific option save/restore hooks, veclib handlers, attribute validation interfaces, and the x86 attribute table used by the rest of the backend and option machinery.
same_name_distinction: Declaration header for the x86 option subsystem; unlike i386-options.cc, it does not implement option logic or attribute handling tables, but exposes the interfaces, globals, and shared declarations used by the rest of the backend.
